checks.summary: Exact HEAD/tree and all 26 protected file hashes match inspection; no tracked/index changes, only the proposal and protected pre-existing roadmap are untracked.
All 33 original proposal files, the exact r1 seal, original receipt and artifacts remain unchanged. User agreement is refinement direction only.
Four authority files and original lock are preserved byte-for-byte; original active/baseline hashes and unused CAL-1 state agree.
All 24 legacy IDs, all 87 exact JSON leaf values and all ten goal sections have explicit dispositions; all replacement IDs exist.
All 33 directly declared aggregate/domain-placeholder commands retain exact old definitions; nine proposed scripts are additive and source scheduling has its own anchored contract.
Twelve outcomes, eight domains, sixteen mandatory failure families and eleven stages are internally consistent; all references resolve and all four partitions remain once with invariants first.

Candidate keeps its floor and focused supporting checks without automatic full-matrix dispatch. All r1 final outcomes/metrics/faults/platforms and integration safeguards remain; purpose and actual cost are recorded.
Fixed coverage/failure/build/resource metrics match the proposed outcomes and current pins; no provisional source field or legacy calibration use is introduced.

Source machine/human gates, generated bootstrap, downstream completion and the bounded target remain separate; human approval, real provider/native platforms and fail-closed eligibility are required by the proposal.
The proposed lock binds exactly the four new authority bytes and the preserved old lock/base; no approval or active new epoch exists.
AGENTS retains its operating/safety text except the declared shared-rule sentence; CONTRACT is an insertion-only change; the seven-file unified diff exactly matches proposed bytes.

Normative-only approval and full package integrity are separate. Five finite mutation cases prove advisory changes affect only package integrity; normative changes, missing/reclassified normative files and classification changes cannot use advisory refresh.

All proposed JSON parses and review links resolve. The approval digest binds normative files; the separate package digest inventories normative, historical, advisory and reproduction files with actual sizes and hashes. Only generated manifests/audit outputs are excluded to avoid self-reference.

limits: Document/hash/reference consistency only; no product or migration implementation is tested.
No authority, acceptance, commissioning, WP6 plan or existing log has been changed.
Source qualification, live human acceptance and runtime policy qualification remain future work.
